case_title: CITY & COUNTY OF SF, DEPT OF HUMAN SERVICES RESPONDENT VS. TONJA JOHNSON APPELLANT

docket_entries.description: RECORD ON APPEAL JUDGEMENT FILED BY APPELLANT JOHNSON, TONJA AS TO RESPONDENT CITY & COUNTY OF SF, DEPT OF HUMAN SERVICES HEARING SET FOR JUN-26-2003 AT 09:00 AM IN DEPT 525
NOTICE OF TIME AND PLACE OF HEARING ON APPEAL
MINUTES FOR JUN-26-2003 9:00 AM FOR DEPT 525

SMALL CLAIMS APPEAL CALENDAR OF JUN-26-2003 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF THURSDAY, JUNE 26, 2003 BY PRO TEM JUDGE DAVID MAY; TRIAL DE NOVO HELD; COURT TO MAIL IN SIGNED JUDGMENT TO COURT WHEN COMPLETED; JUDGE: PRO TEM JUDGE DAVID MAY; REPORTER: NOT REPORTED; CLERK: MARJORIE MANZELLA (D-525, THURS., 26JUN2003).

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CITY & COUNTY OF SF, DEPT OF HUMAN SERVICES RECOVER FROM APPELLANT JOHNSON, TONJA $527.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $527.00, DEFENDANT SHALL PAY THE PLAINTIFF THE SUM OF AT LEAST $20.00 PER MONTH ON OR BEFORE THE FIRST DAY OF EACH MONTH BEGINNING 8/1/03 UNTIL THE BALANCE SHALL BE LESS THAN $20.00; THEN DEFENDANT SHALL PAY THE BALANCE AT THE BEGINNING OF THE NEXT CONSECUTIVE MONTH. IF DEFENDANT FAILS TO PAY ANY OF THE INSTALLMENT PAYMENTS, THE ENTIRE BALANCE SHALL BE DUE AND PAYABLE IMMEDIATELY, AND PLAINTIFF MAY EXECUTE ON THE BALANCE OF THIS JUDGMENT. EXHIBITS ARE ORDERED RETURNED. CASE IS REMANDED TO SMALL CLAIMS PURSUANT TO C.C.P. 116.780(D). NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT AND AFFIDAVIT OF MAILING FILED
STIPULATION OT USE JUDGE PRO TEM AND ORDER FILED.
